{ "html_url": "https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/pull/84", "number": 84, "title": "test(e2e): Clerk user fixtures with automatic cleanup", "body": " Closes #82 ## Summary - Adds Playwright fixtures for Clerk test users with automatic cleanup: - `clerkUser` — single-user, test-scoped (chrome) - `extendClerkUsers([...])` — worker-scoped map for serial multi-user suites - Admin uses `extendClerkUsers(["admin", "empty-sets"])` and passes them into `seedAdmin({ users })` - Host uses `extendClerkUsers(["host"])`; foreign `host.notFound` owner is synthetic (`HOST_FOREIGN_SUBJECT`) — no second Clerk user - Solo / import / player no longer create Clerk users by default (synthetic CLI `--identity` with display name `Visual Seed`). Player keeps opt-in `clerkHost: true` - Removed `shouldResetVisualSeeds` — Convex seed teardown always runs - Rebased onto `main` - Rebaselined ingest/solo Docker goldens to include `by Visual Seed` creator line ## Verification - Fixture smoke: tagged Clerk users cleaned after run - Docker golden update for ingest + solo after restoring synthetic display name
